scripts.test: node --test packages/cli/test/*.test.mjs packages/controller/test/*.test.js packages/profile-tools/test/*.test.js apps/cloud/test/*.test.js tools/test/*.test.js tools/website/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:gamepad: mkdir -p build/gamepad-tests && xcrun clang -fblocks -Wall -Wextra tools/gamepad-report-tests/main.c apps/receiver/Sources/Gamepad.c -framework IOKit -framework CoreFoundation -o build/gamepad-tests/convert && build/gamepad-tests/convert
scripts.test:chat: mkdir -p build/chat-tests && xcrun swiftc -swift-version 5 -module-cache-path build/chat-tests/cache apps/receiver/Sources/ChatDelivery.swift tools/chat-tests.swift -o build/chat-tests/validate && build/chat-tests/validate
scripts.test:access: mkdir -p build/access-check && xcrun swiftc -swift-version 5 -module-cache-path build/monetization-swift-cache apps/receiver/Sources/AccessSession.swift tools/access-tests/main.swift -o build/access-check/tests && build/access-check/tests
